name: サムネイル整合性分析
description: 比較します embedded EXIF thumbnail with the main image を検出するために post-capture modifications.
algorithm: Embedded Thumbnail vs Main Image Structural Comparison
mechanism: JPEG files often contain embedded thumbnails generated at capture time. When the main image is later edited, the thumbnail may remain unchanged, creating detectable 不整合.
parameters: Comparison: SSIM, Histogram 相関, Pixel hash, Thumbnail source: EXIF APP1, 解像度: 160×120
source: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011) — Digital Image Authentication from Thumbnails, SPIE Electronic Imaging
useCase: Detecting image editing を比較することで original thumbnail with potentially modified main image

references.title: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011) — Digital Image Authentication from Thumbnails, SPIE Electronic Imaging

strengths:
• Simple and fast 分析
• High confidence when thumbnail differs
• Non-invasive メタデータ check
• Works on any JPEG with embedded thumbnail
limitations:
• Many images lack embedded thumbnails
• Some editors update thumbnails too
• AI生成の images may not have thumbnails
• Limited to JPEG format
